page.overview:
Who is Anderson?

Anderson is a student at Rommelwood Military School. His friends are unnamed cadet and Platt.

He is one of the boys who bullied Bart and Lisa after they had been enrolled at the school. When Bart passed their test of mettle, they became friends.

He was also the first student in the grade who must pass a physical test called "The Eliminator."

At the end, he and his friends decided to make Bart's life a living hell for the rest of the semester, but after learning graduation is in three hours, they gave up it.
